practice_by_scene.01: Find Address and the complete default map-center coordinate pair without changing the department settings.
practice_by_scene.02: Search for a known resource name and compare the matching markers with the broader view.
practice_by_scene.03: Clear the text filter, hide labels, then restore them and compare the map.
practice_by_scene.04: Hide units, confirm that call markers remain, then restore unit visibility.
practice_by_scene.05: Locate Manage POIs on the map toolbar and open the category list.
practice_by_scene.06: Review the training category name, destination checkbox, color, marker and icon choices.
practice_by_scene.07: Review the category preview before saving, then verify the saved list row.
practice_by_scene.08: Read the saved category color, destination flag and point count before choosing Add.
practice_by_scene.09: Review the separate latitude and longitude fields, fictional name, address and note before Add POI.
practice_by_scene.10: Compare the saved List row with the values entered, then reopen Edit.
practice_by_scene.11: Read back the point identity and coordinate pair in Edit POI without changing the record.
practice_by_scene.12: Filter for the saved point, keep Show POIs selected, and review its plotted position.
practice_by_scene.13: Compare the marker popup with the saved List and Edit values for the same point.
practice_by_scene.14: Hide POIs while retaining the point's text filter and observe the marker disappear.
practice_by_scene.15: Restore Show POIs and confirm that the saved point returns without being recreated.
practice_by_scene.16: Find the category in Map Icon Legend and distinguish a location symbol from resource status.

sector_examples.scenario: Organize named exercise staging points and review them on the operating map.
sector_examples.practice: Verify the saved category, coordinates and marker before using a destination in department operations.

sector_examples.scenario: Keep permitted community paramedicine or mental health response destinations understandable without putting sensitive visit details into general map notes.
sector_examples.practice: Use an appropriate location name and check the saved point under the team's information-handling procedure.

sector_examples.scenario: Group named assembly locations and use category visibility to inspect them.
sector_examples.practice: Compare the saved coordinate pair with the intended location and restore hidden POIs before adding duplicates.

sector_examples.scenario: Organize rally points or other permitted operational locations separately from patrol availability.
sector_examples.practice: Read the location record and map legend without treating its symbol as a personnel status.

sector_examples.scenario: Maintain named contractor assembly or access points for review by the responsible coordinator.
sector_examples.practice: Check the saved name, note and coordinates before relying on a mapped destination.

sector_examples.scenario: Keep site response destinations organized in recognizable point categories.
sector_examples.practice: Review the plotted point and use the site's separate procedure to determine whether the location is suitable and accessible.
